entities.summary: Juha Markku Widing was a Swedish-Finnish professional ice hockey centre and the third Finn to play in the National Hockey League (NHL). Here he spent eight seasons, mostly with the Los Angeles Kings. His nicknames were "Whitey" and "Flying Finn".
